language.script_notes: English is the dominant official/signage language, a legacy of British colonial rule; Swahili also official though less dominant in daily signage than in Kenya/Tanzania. Luganda and other local languages common in speech.

road_furniture.guardrail_type: Standard steel guardrail on major roads; minimal on rural roads.
road_furniture.line_paint: White outside lines with white or yellow inside lines.
road_furniture.curb_style: Minimal formal curbing outside Kampala; red laterite soil frequently visible on unpaved shoulders and roads.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Total, OiLibya, VivoEnergy, Oryx Energies and Hass Petroleum are common fuel-station brands. The Google Street View car in Uganda is a boxy white SUV with square side mirrors, and carries a distinctive black security bar on the front specifically inside national parks.

architecture.roof_style: Simple pitched roofs, commonly corrugated metal.
architecture.wall_construction: Concrete-block and painted-brick construction in towns; simpler mud-brick construction in rural areas.
architecture.wall_color_palette: Often brightly painted shopfronts and small businesses; muted concrete-block tones elsewhere; red laterite soil visible around many buildings.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Small roadside shops and markets; Kampala's hilly, densely built urban core; simple rural homesteads amid banana plantations.

nature.vegetation: Banana plantations are a defining feature of the Lake Victoria basin in southern Uganda; lowland rainforest grades into montane forest at higher elevation; savanna woodland and grassland in drier northern areas.
nature.terrain: Landlocked, part of the East African Great Lakes region — Lake Victoria (Africa's largest lake) forms the southern border area; generally hilly and green, especially compared to drier parts of Kenya.
nature.climate_signature: Stable, humid tropical climate nationwide, supporting lush year-round vegetation — noticeably greener overall than much of Kenya's drier savanna.

vehicles.plate_color: White plate on the front, yellow plate on the back (the back plate can be square or long format).
vehicles.plate_format: Letter-digit combinations similar in style to other former British East African territories.
vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: Boda boda motorcycle taxis (Bajaj, Honda, Suzuki, TVS, Yamaha) are extremely common and a strong East Africa/Uganda tell, alongside shared taxi vans.

google_coverage.camera_generation: Mix of official coverage and Trekker imagery.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: Concentrated around Kampala and major towns; sparser in rural areas.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared East African Community membership, similar English/Swahili bilingual signage, similar boda boda/matatu transport culture
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Uganda is landlocked with no ocean coastline, unlike Kenya's Indian Ocean coast; Uganda is generally greener and hillier (Lake Victoria basin, banana plantations) versus Kenya's drier acacia savanna in much of the interior; Kenya's Google car has a visible front snorkel that Uganda's boxy white SUV lacks.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Great Lakes region geography, similar hilly green terrain and banana cultivation
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Rwanda's official languages include French and Kinyarwanda alongside English, with different road signage conventions; Rwanda is also considerably smaller and hillier throughout ('Land of a Thousand Hills') than Uganda's more varied terrain.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared Lake Victoria shoreline, similar East African savanna/lake-basin vegetation
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Tanzania has an Indian Ocean coastline that landlocked Uganda lacks; Tanzania's Swahili-first signage is more dominant than Uganda's English-first convention.
